REST/WebSocket surface of the LeRobot remote-control gateway.

* **`/api/*`** — Internal API used by the web UI. **Once a password is set in Settings**, it requires
  a session cookie (`core/authgate.py`). If none is set it stays open as before, and the UI warns about that.
  `/api/estop/*` is open either way — there is no reason to block stopping, and if the heartbeat
  gets a 401, estopd SIGKILLs the running inference.
* **`/api/ext/v1/*`** — Contract for external systems. Requires the `PIPER_API_TOKEN` Bearer token, and if it is
  unset the whole thing returns 503. Breaking changes create v2 (`feature/external-api.md`).
* **`/ws`** — Log and process-state streaming. It cannot be called from Swagger.

⚠ **Calling from here moves the real robot.** This page is not a read-only reference but the live
gateway. Endpoints that start inference, recording or teleop also carry the heartbeat obligation
(`POST /api/estop/heartbeat`, 2.5 s timeout), and Swagger UI does not send heartbeats, so estopd will
SIGKILL soon after. Call start-type endpoints from the UI or an external client, and use
`/docs` mainly for lookups and checks.
